'''Fia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Fia was unaware of her Forcefulness and was working as a crew member on a [[Garbage scow/Legends|garbage scow]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] when [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Till'in]] came across her in his travels. It was few days before she met player's character. Fearful of the Kel Dor' appearance, Fia fired her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] at the Jedi, though he deflected the attack with ease. Embarrassed by her attack, Fia accepted the Jedi's offer of [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Tython/Legends|Tythonian]] [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprentice, Fia continued to send letters of apology to Master Till'in, much to his annoyance.<ref name="TOR" />
